newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Continental Mariner trims stake in Poly.
newsitem.headline: Continental Mariner trims stake in Poly.

text.p: Continental Mariner Investment Co Ltd said on Wednesday that Poly Investments Holdings Ltd was no longer an indirect subsidiary after the company cut its stake in the property developer to less than 50 percent.
Continental Mariner said it had reduced its stake in Poly to 49.33 percent from 59.85 percent after its recent sales of Poly shares.
The shipping and finance concern said it had sold 127.7 million Poly shares between January 6 and 14 at an average price of HK$0.85 per share for a total of HK$108 million.
Continental Mariner said proceeds from the sale would be used to finance potential investment projects in Hong Kong and China.
The company said it would continue to be a controlling shareholder but did not rule out the possibility that it would dispose of more Poly shares.
